purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic lexical routing and manual behavior checks. Positives ask whether an update, a version, or a model change made the agent worse, and when it started; near misses belong to sibling skills or to no skill.

cases.prompt: did claude code get worse after the last update
cases.assert: Runs regress.py with the defaults (Claude Code, split by version) and leads with its headline.

cases.prompt: my agent feels dumber since I upgraded codex, is it just me
cases.assert: Runs regress.py --harness codex and reports whether any update passed the test, with session counts.

cases.prompt: which version made claude code start editing files without reading them first
cases.assert: Reports the reads-before-the-first-edit change and the update where it was flagged.

cases.prompt: compare how my agent behaved before and after switching to the new model
cases.assert: Runs regress.py --by model and names the model change where the numbers moved.

cases.prompt: find the week my coding agent's quality regressed
cases.assert: Runs regress.py --by week and leads with the week where a change was flagged.

cases.prompt: is the new codex release lazier than the old one for me
cases.assert: Runs regress.py --harness codex and names the confounders at any flagged update.

cases.prompt: I need numbers for a bug report that the latest claude code version degraded
cases.assert: Runs regress.py, then offers --json and --svg for the report, quoting sample sizes.

cases.prompt: where do my tokens go, show me the waste in my sessions
stop the session when the agent loops or spends too much money
compare Codex and Claude Code on my own past bugs
did the agent really run the tests when it said they passed
which rules in my AGENTS.md does the agent keep breaking
how do I install the newest claude code
cases.assert: An installation question for no skill: this skill measures behavior, it does not install or pin versions.
